Hi Allison,

It is exciting to see Son of Steel arrive this spring as the second half of the Children of Ash duology, following Axel Ashersson and Petra on a sea voyage to Sida. A Norse-inspired world of Häxa witches and a hero whose strength carries a curse is a memorable setup, especially from the author behind The Cartographer's War series.
